decisions.label: Feeding reach (m)
decisions.note: Ed, 3 November: a tap of the sigil button feeds the bottom of her stack a berry this near her (the nearest un-taken one is marked, with the prompt). 15 by default.

decisions.label: Feeding: travel speed (× its pace)
decisions.note: Ed, 3 November: a fed animal goes to its berry at its own pace times this, not much faster ("otherwise feeding berries becomes a way of moving creatures quickly rather than levelling them up"). 1 by default; about 1 to 1.2.

decisions.label: Feeding: hold to put down (s)
decisions.note: With a berry marked, a tap of the sigil button feeds and holding it this long puts the bottom sigil down instead. 0.3 by default.
